content:
elaine-sales: Quick sync — HarborHealth (HIPAA-sensitive) wants a short POC using medgpt-xl-v2 on Dedicated/Private. Can we confirm model format, quantization paths, and any blockers for HSM/KMS integration? They care about latency for 2k context.

matt-ml: Thanks. Do we have the HF link and model artifact type? gguf/pt/torchscript matters for our runtime.

elaine-sales: HF repo: https://huggingface.co/harbor/medgpt-xl-v2 . Owner says it's PyTorch + a converted ggml export. Size ~38B.

devon-solutions: 38B ggml -> good. Main ask: 2k context, low latency. We should recommend Q4_0 or Q4_K_M variants; Q8 could be fallback. Need to verify auto KV cache behavior with 2k — our runtime should handle but quantized kernels differ.

olivia-engineering: I'll run a quick compatibility scan against our quantized kernel table and GPU kernels. Pinging results in a sec.

deploy-bot: [automated-scan] starting model compatibility check for harbor/medgpt-xl-v2 @ 1777777022

deploy-bot: [automated-scan] artifacts: model uses custom RMSNorm op -> flagged. Suggested: provide a torchscript export with fused RMSNorm or we provide an operator shim. (severity: medium)

matt-ml: Custom RMSNorm is common. We can either 1) onboard a shim in runtime for the op, or 2) ask client to ship a torchscript/onnx export with fused kernels. Shims increase maintenance; prefer export if Harbor can produce it.

anya-security: Re: HIPAA & enterprise: Harbor requires HSM (FIPS) for key wrap and an audit of our Private deploy package. Also they asked if model weights can be pinned and if we support in-transit eviction policies. Need SOC2 cert statement and network flow diagram.

devon-solutions: Noted. For HSM we support external KMS/HSM via our customer KMS integration (KMIP + AWS CloudHSM / Azure KeyVault). We'll need a short runbook for cert team. Olivia — can you add KMS integration note to the POC checklist?

olivia-engineering: Adding now. Also, kernel scan shows we lack a production Q4_K_M kernel for the fused RMSNorm path on A100 80GB; fallback to Q8 will work but cost/latency hit ~1.6x in perf estimates. I'll paste small config snippet Harbor can use for canary routing and policy.

olivia-engineering: ```json
{"model": "medgpt-xl-v2",
 "variants": ["q4_0_fused", "q8_fallback"],
 "routing": {"priority": ["dedicated","hosted"], "canary_pct": 10},
 "kv_cache": {"enabled": true, "max_seq_len": 2048}
}
```

elaine-sales: Perfect. I'll ask Harbor if they can produce a torchscript/onnx export. If not, we should estimate effort to implement the RMSNorm shim and the perf delta.

matt-ml: Quick perf estimate: Q4_fused -> ~9ms/token on A100@2k, Q8 fallback -> ~14ms/token. Memory fits with shard plan. I'll write these numbers into the POC doc for pricing calc.

anya-security: Also confirm retention controls: can we auto-delete logs after 30 days in Private? They asked about token logging and pii scrubbing presets.

devon-solutions: Yes, retention policy configurable; we can enable token redact + pii scrub flow. I'll add to runbook.

elaine-sales: Great. Action items summary:
- Ask Harbor for torchscript/onnx export (elaine)
- Provide SOC2 + network diagram (anya)
- Add KMS/HSM runbook + retention + PII scrub options (devon)
- Engineering to estimate RMSNorm shim effort & perf delta if Harbor can't export (olivia/matt)

elaine-sales: Target next update by EOD Friday (ts 1777777350). Thanks all :thumbsup:
